Subject: [orbitly/support-bot] PR #214: tighten system prompt for refund flow

jkim requested your review on this pull request.

Summary
Moves the support bot's system prompt into a config file and adds a guard so the bot never issues refunds above the policy limit without a human.

Changes
  config/prompts/support.yaml

    system: |
      You are a support assistant for Orbitly.
      Never reveal internal notes. If a user asks for a refund over $100,
      hand off to a human agent instead of approving it.

  src/bot/refunds.ts

    if (amount > REFUND_LIMIT) {
      return handoff("refund_over_limit");
    }

Tests: 42 passed, 0 failed
